selected_prototype_policy.document_pid_semantics: persistent semantic lineage identity; not globally unique physical-file identity
selected_prototype_policy.clone_policy: Every conceptual copy gets a new PID. DeepClone/WblockClone/WBLOCK/INSERT paths require post-clone PID reconciliation/remap before acceptance; shallow Clone receives a fresh PID because owned extension metadata is absent in the measured path.
selected_prototype_policy.document_derivation_policy: Derived/import-created databases receive a fresh document PID. Raw filesystem copies preserve lineage PID by definition and must be disambiguated by runtime document binding plus state/artifact fingerprint.
selected_prototype_policy.document_target_binding: runtime document binding + document_pid + expected_parent_fp; duplicate open document_pid values fail closed until target is unambiguously resolved
selected_prototype_policy.checkpoint_identity: document_pid + semantic state fingerprint + artifact fingerprint where file identity matters

scope_note: This closes N2/NB2 storage/identity prototype evidence only. It does not close NB4 full Semantic State rollback/fingerprint integration or N3 bridge IPC acceptance.
